spiritgiven.comments:
You had lots of travel and the check was not always by defence if they were within 3 metres.
We could not hear the calls and you did not make any hand signals.
You always wanted to change our minds of you thoughts.

When there was a call the play stopped for 2-3 minutes. We felt that the players didn’t want to resolve the problems quickly. Please pay much more attention to timing and communication when resolving calls!
Calls were resolved quickly, and the communication was pretty good.
If you can, please look through the rules.

A játékosok nagyon jol kezelték a hívásokat, viszont az edző nagyon agresszív volt,sokszor csapkodott a pálya szélén.
Pozitív: Végig küzdött az egész csapat.
ENG: The players handled the calls very well, but the coach was very aggressive, often lashing out on the sidelines.
Positive: The whole team fought throughout.

Úgy gondoltuk, hogy a játékosok nagyon sokszor csak a game advisor nézetét vették figyelembe( ami nem rossz) de sokszor éreztük feleslegesnek a hívásokat.
Az utolsó szituációban (két játékos egyszerre kapta el a zónában a passzt) ebben az esetben a korong világosan a támadóé.
We thought that the players often only took into account the view of the game advisor (which is not bad), but we often felt that the calls were unnecessary.
In the last situation (two players caught the pass in the zone at the same time), in this case the disc clearly belongs to the attacker.
Very intensive and enjoyable match! Good luck for the finals.

A hívások megváltoztatása beszélgetés közben.
Rengeteg travel, fault, és dangerous play.
Több játékosunk testi épsége sérült a játékuk miatt.
Semmi megértés nem volt felénk a hívások kapcsán.
Többszörös beismerés és spirit timeout beszélgetés után folytatták a lépéshibákat.
Change calls during a conversation.
Lots of travel, fouls and dangerous play.
Several of our players have been injured because of their game.
We had no understanding regarding the calls.
After several admissions and spirit timeout conversations, they continued with the missteps.

Number 0 is having too much body contact when defending

Tough game Hungary! Explanations, Rules: Multiple instances in which we had to explain basic rules like violations and infractions. Fair: Many exclaimed reactions when we made calls. Almost always there was a fight in the calls. Attitude: Even though it was mostly one player, the repetition of it is what makes it a 0. The decision to not take him out of the field or even talk to him is a team decision. At the end many players were also very disrespectful. Com: No hand signals.

4. Very positive sideline encouraging both teams during turnovers scores and overall a great atmosphere on and off the field.
5. A lot of the players were really eager to communicate and understand different perspectives. Good Spirit!! Keep it up!!

The calls took a lot more time than the should have, it was hard for us to resolve a problem with your strong and not willing to change opinion. There were a few problems with the level of your rules awareness.We felt that u interrupted in the calls and wanted to talk about your perspective, only if the view of yours, was in your favour. There was too much contact and dangerous play.
For more details you can talk to spirit director.

Sentimos que no tuvieron justificación en el reglamento al hacer algunos llamados. Muchos llamados fueron realizados para sacar ventaja, incluso cuando los asesores de juego estaban involucrados y daban su perspectiva imparcial ellos continuaban sosteniendo su llamado
En cuanto a la actitud positiva y autocontrol y comunicación, hubo un jugador que durante todo el partido fue irrespetuoso y agresivo al contestar los llamados, incluso cuando no estaba involucrados en ellos. 
We feel that they had no justification in the regulations when making some calls. Many calls were made to take advantage, even when gambling advisors were involved and gave their unbiased perspective they continued to maintain their call.
Regarding positive attitude and self-control and communication, there was one player who throughout the game was disrespectful and aggressive when answering calls, even when he was not involved in them.
This was a very spirited game they communicated effectively and we had no issues that could not be resolved between matchups. They made great plays that always were safe and did not make contact.
